# Goban Studio v1.1.1

A dependency and packaging refresh. The course, rules, scoring and interface
are unchanged from v1.1.0.

## Download and first launch

| Platform | File | First launch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `GobanStudio-macOS-arm64.dmg` or `.zip` | Ad-hoc signed, **not notarized**. Right-click the app → Open once. If macOS still blocks it: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Goban\ Studio.app` |
| Windows (x64) | `GobanStudio-Windows-x64.zip` | **Not Authenticode-signed.** If SmartScreen appears, choose More info → Run anyway. WebView2 is preinstalled on Windows 10/11. |

Every release asset has a line in `SHA256SUMS`. The app remains fully offline.

## Engine

- **KataGo 1.18.1** replaces 1.16.0 in the 19×19 sidecar. This is the latest
  KataGo release with official Eigen CPU builds. KataGo 1.18.2 only changes
  the CUDA Turing attention path, publishes no Eigen binary and gives this
  CPU sidecar no functional benefit.
- The macOS sidecar is built from the v1.18.1 source with the Eigen backend.
  The Windows sidecar uses the official Eigen build and ships its MSVC,
  OpenSSL, bzip2 and Visual C++ runtime DLLs. The release gate checks that
  those DLLs are present in the ZIP.
- **Moka v2.1** is the current 9×9 net. The bundled weights and manifest match
  the upstream `millionco/moka` files byte for byte; the UI still labels the
  opponent `Moka 9×9`.
- The 19×19 network remains the small b6c96 network. The latest mainline
  transformer networks are 200 MB or more and are not suitable for the
  CPU-only sidecar.

## Build and packaging

- Node.js 24 is now the minimum; CI tests Node 24 and the latest Node 26 LTS.
- Zig remains at 0.16.0 because Native SDK 0.11.0 pins that toolchain and
  rejects Zig 0.17. Upgrading Zig alone would break both desktop builds.
- GitHub Actions use checkout v7, setup-node v7, upload-artifact v7 and
  download-artifact v8.
- `@sabaki/go-board` 1.4.3 and esbuild 0.28.2 remain current; `npm audit`
  reports zero vulnerabilities.
- The app and third-party licences still travel inside every package.
- The Windows ZIP excludes the WebView2 profile created by the release
  self-test; the gate now rejects a package if that profile leaks back in.

## Verification

- 28 Node tests, the content gate and the four-language checks pass.
- Native SDK tests pass 5/5 and the ReleaseFast executable builds.
- The packaged macOS app opens a 19×19 board, reaches the native bridge and
  receives a KataGo move.
- The packaged Windows GUI runs the same bridge and KataGo self-test before
  the ZIP is uploaded.

## Honest limits

- macOS notarization and Windows Authenticode require certificates this
  project does not have. The packages remain ad-hoc/unsigned; the install
  notes give the exact first-launch steps.
- Review is the local shape/influence estimate, not KataGo win-rate analysis.
- Japanese life-and-death is resolved by the player marking dead stones; the
  app does not claim to settle disputed positions automatically.

KataGo is MIT licensed. The bundled b6c96 network is distributed with KataGo.
